pages.title: What is BugText?
pages.summary: A one-minute tour: a fast Mac editor for Markdown notes, PDFs and code, with AI that stays under your control.

pages.title: Install BugText
pages.summary: Drag BugText to Applications, open it past the Not Opened warning, and keep it updated.

pages.title: Your first five minutes
pages.summary: Open a folder, write a first note with a preview beside it, and find anything with the command palette.

pages.title: Check what an AI agent changed
pages.summary: Let a coding agent work in your notes, then see every file it touched and review each change before you accept it.

pages.title: Keep a web page as a note
pages.summary: Import a page, read it, save the parts that matter and turn them into tasks.

pages.title: Fix a PDF without another app
pages.summary: Correct a typo, cover a line, sign or reorder pages in a PDF, with the original kept safe.

pages.title: Editor basics
pages.summary: View modes, the format bar, checklists, tables, pasted images and saving.

pages.title: Diagrams, callouts and more
pages.summary: Mermaid diagrams, math, callouts, footnotes and code blocks in the preview.

pages.title: Templates and daily notes
pages.summary: Start notes from templates or note types, keep a daily note, and jot a line with Quick Note.

pages.title: Focus, goals and spelling
pages.summary: Write in focus mode, set a word goal, and let macOS check your spelling.

pages.title: Present a note
pages.summary: Show a Markdown note as slides with speaker notes and a presenter window.

pages.title: Export and citations
pages.summary: Save a note as PDF, Word or an image, with presets and citations from your reference library.

pages.title: Folders, windows and workspaces
pages.summary: Work in a folder of notes, split the window, open more windows, and save layouts as workspaces.

pages.title: Search and replace
pages.summary: Find in a note, find in the whole folder, filter by tag or property, and replace across files safely.

pages.title: Links, bookmarks and graph
pages.summary: Link notes to each other, see backlinks and unlinked mentions, jump with bookmarks, and look at the graph.

pages.title: Properties, tasks and status
pages.summary: Give notes properties and a status, track tasks across a folder, and see a project at a glance.

pages.title: Import a web page, Word or CSV
pages.summary: Turn a web page, a Word document or a CSV file into a Markdown note that remembers where it came from.

pages.title: History, recovery and Git
pages.summary: Get back unsaved work after a crash, restore an older version, and commit to Git without leaving the app.

pages.title: Capture while reading
pages.summary: Save an excerpt or a task from what you are reading, with a link back to the exact passage.

pages.title: Review queue
pages.summary: See which notes changed outside your own editing, what changed in each, and mark them reviewed.

pages.title: Read and annotate PDFs
pages.summary: Read, search, highlight and comment on PDFs, and send your highlights to a note.

pages.title: Edit a PDF
pages.summary: Add or replace text, cover parts of a page, recognise scanned text, and reorder pages.

pages.title: Set up AI
pages.summary: Connect a coding CLI or an API provider, and choose which engine each AI feature uses.

pages.title: Chat with your notes
pages.summary: Ask about the open note or the whole folder, attach files, and apply answers as reviewed edits.

pages.title: Quick actions and recipes
pages.summary: Proofread or rewrite in one step, save your own actions, and turn repeated jobs into recipes.

pages.title: Connect an AI agent
pages.summary: Let Claude Code or Codex read and edit your notes through BugText's MCP server.

pages.title: Settings
pages.summary: What each Settings page controls: General, Editing, Export, Git, Themes, Shortcuts and AI.

pages.title: Keyboard shortcuts
pages.summary: The default keys for files, views, writing and navigation, and how to change them.

pages.title: Privacy
pages.summary: Your notes stay on your Mac. What BugText sends over the network, and only when you ask it to.

pages.title: Troubleshooting
pages.summary: Fixes for the Not Opened warning, Keychain prompts, missing export tools and other common problems.
